scope: Original installed KDE TaskManager context menu capability mask for BWM-owned models; isolated original-menu action routing, not full Task.qml rendering

contract.sourceCheck: QQmlContext resolved ContextMenu.qml, QFile/qrc byte hash
contract.mask: one nonexclusive public QActionGroup per QAction; no QML enabled binding replaced
contract.unmask: enable own individual group before removeAction to recompute current explicit state
contract.unreviewedSource: disable affected menu and record lastError
contract.foreignActionGroupOnUnsupportedAction: disable affected menu, preserve foreign group
contract.groupPolicy: require provider marker and capability from every group member

assertions: actual installed org.kde.plasma.icontasks, native Task.qml showContextMenu function and ContextMenu.qml handlers loaded
three unsupported native actions disabled in individual and grouped menu
disabled above action emits no triggered signal or source request
original minimize handler routes individual request with fixture identity to BwmTaskSource
original grouped minimize routes two requests for two distinct fixture windows
nonexclusive mask preserves simultaneous checked states
foreign application QAction with same icon remains enabled and ungrouped
suspension closes original popup and preserves explicit false/true state of surviving actions
row removal closes individual and grouped menus before stale task indices remain visible
notFaultInjected: each individual structural signal other than removal
